description: Blog or news: a Markdown content collection, a list page and post pages with dates, breadcrumbs and BlogPosting JSON-LD. Posts are listed in llms.txt. Drafts build in dev only.

boundaries: Posts are Markdown in `src/content/posts/`. Code blocks use Prism classes; never switch to Shiki, which writes inline styles the CSP blocks.

manual: Write the first real post in `src/content/posts/` and delete `first-post.md`. Rename `/blog` to `/news` (folder, nav item) if that suits the site.
